results.task: My regular costs: phone 65 a month, internet 80 a month, streaming 15.99 a month, insurance 1,200 a year, gym 10 a week, other 25 a month. What do they add up to?
results.reply:
Your 6 costs come to $3,951.88 a year.
That is $329.32 a month.
Insurance is the biggest: $1,200.00 a year, $100.00 a month.
Internet: $960.00 a year, $80.00 a month.
Phone: $780.00 a year, $65.00 a month.
Gym: $520.00 a year, $43.33 a month.
Other: $300.00 a year, $25.00 a month.
Streaming: $191.88 a year, $15.99 a month.
Questions to ask before you call, the same for every cost: What is the price today? What did it cost a year ago? Is there a cheaper plan with the same things in it? Can I stop this with no fee? When does my current deal end?
Note: this only adds up what was typed. Weekly costs use 52 weeks, so they are estimates. It never calls, cancels or pays anything.
